full_judgment:
9. He shows from evidence of PW 4 Saheb Ali who stated that on his arrival at the occurrence house he found father, mother and brothers of deceased Jamir. He shows also from evidence of PW 3 Shamsuddin Biswas, PW 4 Saheb Ali Biswas and PW 5 Golam Hossain Biswas that Amir. Brother of deceased Jamir, told that Daud Ali and Rabi killed Jamir. He contends that father, mother and brother Amir were most vital witnesses to come to Court to prove and establish that Daud with Rabi killed Jamir, but those probable vital witnesses including other inmates of the occurrence house were withheld by prosecution. This, according to him, will bring presumption under section 114G Evidence Act. He also submits that source of informant about the occurrence was, according to PWs 3, 4 and 5, said full brother Amir who’s non- production and non-examination cuts the connecting links. He submits that victim slept alone in his ghar as his wife was in the father-in-law's house as per first information report (Exhibit 1). She was also a vital witness to give light as to whether they had any family dispute and ill feeling with accused Daud Ali. According to him, non-bringing of the wife of the deceased in the picture will bring adverse presumption also. 

 14. Learned Advocate shows that Exhibits 2, 3 and 4 such Map Index and seizure list were prepared by main investigation officer SI Afzalul Islam (CS witness No. 12) who was not examined being vital witness. He argues that non- examination of said vital and main investigation officer deprived the defence of chance and opportunity of cross- examining him on various aspects of investigation. He submits that non-examination of main investigation officer Afzal will be fatal for prosecution as it will bring adverse presumption as it prejudiced the defence seriously. 

 15. Learned Advocate submits that from the charge-sheet it will be evident that both the accused- appellants were absconding. He contends that absconsion cannot by itself prove the guilt of the accused. It might happen due to apprehension of police harassment. He shows from record that charge-sheet was submitted on 10-6-1992 and both the accused surrendered in Court on 6-8-1992. He also urges that prosecution failed to show by any means that the accused absconded with guilty knowledge with regard to their any complicity with the occurrence. He therefore, argues that no adverse presumption can be taken against them for their above absconsion. 

 18. Learned Assistant Attorney-General submits that place of occurrence was the ghar where Jamir slept in the occurrence night. Perhaps after he was assaulted inside the ghar Jamir tried to chase the assailants and in such attempt he went out and fell on the courtyard which was shown by investigation officer by letter “ক” (Ka) in the Map Index Exhibits 2, 3 as place of occurrence. According to him above slight anomaly will not matter much. He also argues that main investigation officer, Afzalul Islam who prepared Exhibits 2, 3, 4 Map Index and seizure list was not produced and examined as witness at the trial. But part PW 10 SI Zulfiker Ali stated and proved Exhibits 2-4 during trial, PW 10 was cross-examined by the defence. Therefore non-examination of main investigation officer namely, Afzal, cannot be fatal and it cannot bring any adverse presumption against prosecution nor can it prejudice the defence as agitated on behalf of appellants. 

 34. Even mother, father and brothers of Jamir were not cited witness in the charge-sheet nor they were examined as witness at the trial when it was disclosed in the deposition of PW 4 Saheb Ali in cross-examination that he saw mother, father and brothers of Jamir when he arrived at the occurrence house. Withholding and non-examination of the parents and other brother of Jamir namely, Amir as witnesses in the case would be fatal for the prosecution and their non-examination without proper explanation would bring adverse presumption under section 114 G Evidence Act against prosecution. It also appears that in such a case no other neighbours came as witness to support the prosecution. 

 49. We noticed earlier that 10 PWs were examined Out of 13 CS witnesses. We discussed above that CS witness No. 12 SI and 1st investigation officer Afzalul Islam who prepared Map. Index and seizure list Exhibits 2, 3 and 4 was withheld by prosecution without offering any reasonable explanation at all. We already observed that said 1st investigation officer Afzalul Islam being a vital and most important witness, his non- examination without any proper explanation will bring presumption under section 114G Evidence Act.
